title: Winterspring
body: Winterspring is a high valley of snow and ice in the mountains of northern Kalimdor, reached through the tunnels of Timbermaw Hold. Long ago the Highborne raised the city of Kel'Theril here, and their cursed spirits still drift over a frozen lake. The goblins of the Steamwheedle Cartel keep the trading post of Everlook at the valley's crossroads, frostsabers prowl the northern heights, maddened wildkin guard old sacred places, and blue dragons lair in the caverns of Mazthoril, while in the far south demons stand between the valley and Mount Hyjal.

parts.body: For a time necropolises of the Scourge hang in the sky above the snows, and its armies spread across the valley beneath them.

title: Everlook
body: Everlook is a trading post of the Steamwheedle Cartel, built where the trade routes of Winterspring meet, and like the Cartel's other towns it is neutral ground: its goblin bruisers have no patience for anyone who spills blood within its walls. An inn, a market and the only bank in the valley serve travelers of every race, and the Argent Dawn and the Thorium Brotherhood both keep envoys here.

title: Starfall Village
body: Starfall Village is a small night elf settlement on the road between Everlook and Frostsaber Rock, the only Alliance outpost in Winterspring, keeping the old Ban'Thallow Barrow Den. Wynd Nightchaser knows a great deal about the valley and its secrets, and a dwarf of the Explorers' League rests here after wildkin chased him from his dig, smashing his camp for an amulet he had unearthed.

title: Lake Kel'Theril
body: In the center of Winterspring lies frozen Lake Kel'Theril, and on its shore the ruins of a Highborne city broken in the Sundering. Its sorcerers once stole a sacred relic, hoping to siphon its power, but the ritual failed: the relic shattered in a tremendous explosion and its pieces were driven deep beneath the ice. The thieves were cursed to remain, and their anguished spirits still drift over the water, searching for the fragments of what doomed them.

parts.body: The relic was the Crystal of Zin-Malor, an artifact able to contain and control strong arcane forces, taken from a temple in Eldarath, in Azshara.
sources: quest 5244 description (cursed race bound to the place of the ritual, relic shattered and driven below the ice)

parts.body: Mended and shown to the one remorseful spirit among them, the crystal releases the cursed Highborne to let go of the past and rest.

title: Frostsaber Rock
body: In the far north of Winterspring a great tor juts above the snow, and around it gather the frostsabers, the most feral of all the great cats, under their matriarch Shy-Rotam. About four thousand years ago Tyrande Whisperwind saved the frostsaber queen from rampaging giants, the frostmaul of Frostwhisper Gorge to the south, and since that day the cats have been allies of the night elves. At the top of the rock a night elf trains frostsabers to carry riders.

title: Mazthoril
body: Mazthoril is a deep cavern of ice in central Winterspring, home of the blue dragonflight in these lands, its halls guarded by wyrmkin and drakes. At its peak, reached only by cobalt runes that carry those who hold a scale of the flight, dwells Haleh, the matron protectorate, a consort of Malygos who receives visitors in the guise of a high elf.

parts.body: The Aspects insist that dragons stay out of mortal affairs, yet Haleh will not stand idle while Nefarian schemes behind Blackrock Mountain, and she offers her power to mortals instead.

title: Winterfall Village
body: Far to the east lies Winterfall Village, home of the Winterfall furbolgs. The tribe, once allies of the Timbermaw, was never known for aggression, yet its warriors now fall upon nearly anything that comes near, and they guard the Frostfire Hot Springs in the west fiercely. The Timbermaw say the change began with the strange demands of High Chief Winterfall, and his people carry flasks of a strange green liquid that almost glows.

parts.body: The firewater is Deadwood sludge from Felwood, toxic until mixed with the water of the hot springs, which keeps its power over those who drink it.
sources: quest 5121 description (not a normally aggressive tribe, under orders from their chief; head east to Winterfall Village)

parts.body: Behind the chief stood a demon, Xandivious, dominating the tribe. With its essence the Winterfall's long healing can at last begin, slow as it will be.

title: Darkwhisper Gorge
body: In the far south of Winterspring the air turns thick and muggy and the sky grows dark: this is Darkwhisper Gorge, a maze of tunnels and chasms where demons have made their home. Deeper still, a runed gateway faces toward Mount Hyjal, sealed and silent. At the bottom of the gorge a high elf earthcaller studies the elements; nearly a decade ago his goblin student opened a fissure here, spoke with an agent of Therazane, and was swallowed whole.

parts.body: The demons' presence, a dwarf scholar believes, warms the Frostfire Hot Springs far to the north, though no volcano lies anywhere near them.

title: Owl Wing Thicket
body: Owl Wing Thicket is a series of caves along a ridge in southern Winterspring, overrun by crazed and moontouched owlbeasts, which seem to have gone mad from exposure to the very thing they guard. At the top of the ridge, the night elf scholar Ranshalla believes, lies an ancient altar of Elune, which incantations carved in the ruins of Kel'Theril may open.

parts.body: The altar once held a gem through which Elune's priestesses spoke with the goddess, and to guard it she gave them the wildkin. Without her guidance the wildkin have grown feral, yet they still guard her sacred places.
sources: warcraft.wiki.gg/wiki/Owl_Wing_Thicket (series of caves in southern Winterspring, berserk, moontouched and crazed owlbeasts)

parts.body: A glowing necklace taken from one carries a single source of power: the wildkin were made by Elune to guard her most sacred places.
